entities.summary: Park Bo-gum (b. 1990-06-16, Seoul) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Seoul and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
